# Centerfield + GrowthBook
Date: 2026-08-28 | Duration: 49.65999984741211m

## Summary
The discussion focused on the evaluation of GrowthBook as a potential replacement for Centerfield's current internal experimentation platform, which is limited in scope and scalability. Centerfield is looking for a solution that can support a broader range of use cases beyond call center lead generation. The platform's ability to handle server-side rendering and execute complex experiments was emphasized as a strong advantage. GrowthBook's multi-use case coverage, open-source nature, and rapid innovation driven by customer feedback were highlighted. The pricing structure was also discussed, including options ranging from free to $200,000 for enterprise solutions. The meeting concluded with plans for a trial usage period and a follow-up meeting to assess outcomes.

## Keywords
experimentation, server-side testing, open source, feature flags, pricing model, data warehouse integration

## Action Items

**Neal Cabbage**
Explore GrowthBook platform using existing enterprise account and invite team members to trial functionality (34:23)
Coordinate with GrowthBook team to provision enterprise support features for trial account (36:39)
Schedule a follow-up meeting with GrowthBook team after September 11th to review usage and address questions (47:13)
Gather feedback and questions from internal users after trial use to prepare for next demo/discussion (47:13)

**GrowthBook Team**
Provision enterprise trial account for Neal and send relevant documentation and support materials (36:39)
Provide GA4-to-BigQuery integration guides and documentation for easier data onboarding (44:00)
